h15.text: We implemented the Road to Regis program, which is a last-dollar tuition program providing full tuition coverage to students after federal, state, and institutional merit scholarship dollars are awarded. Eligible students must be dependent as defined on the FAFSA and family AGI must be $75,000 or less as reported on FAFSA. Students must have a 3.0 or higher HS GPA and must be a resident of CO, WY, KS, NE, OK, AZ, NM, or UT.
